title: Add settlement receipt migration planning
summary: Local settlement receipts have correlation fields, but legacy receipt backfill and migration tooling need a dry-run plan before mutation support.
expectedFailureModes: Legacy settlement receipts are mutated without a dry-run migration review.
Receipt backfill cannot distinguish missing memory correlation from malformed receipt data.
Migration docs omit rollback and audit expectations.
nextAction: Add a settlement receipt migration dry-run that reports legacy uncorrelated receipts, expected correlation inputs, and unsupported mutation refusal behavior.
